_comment: Idle Business Kit theme pack: Dhaba Rush (the reference pack). Phase 2 (9 Nov 2026): the game block, the switchable systems and the business words. Engine code reads this through ThemePack; later phases move counters, layouts, text, story and the UI skin in here too.

money._comment: symbol before money amounts; number_style auto = lakh/crore grouping on Indian device locales (the player can switch it in Settings), indian / intl = always that style.

store._comment: In-app products: placeholder titles and prices (the real ones come from the store at run time). Ids are the engine's; the store console must use the same ids.
